title: Your Credit Card Company Makes Money Even When You Pay It Off In Full
description:
Educational purposes only. Not financial advice.

Every time you swipe a credit card, the merchant pays a small interchange fee to your card's issuing bank, split with the card network. That fee gets charged whether you pay your statement in full or carry a balance for months. It's a quiet, historically consistent revenue stream built into every transaction, long before any interest ever gets charged.

Educational purposes only. Not financial advice. This video is general information about markets, business and economics, and does not consider your personal circumstances. Always do your own research and consider speaking to a licensed financial professional before making any financial decision.
